God's rest, Genesis 2, for the first week. God made the heavens, the earth, the sea, life, and man, and on the seventh day, God ended his work, and he rested, and he blessed that day, and sanctified it. The world did not just appear by accident, and the rhythm of one day in seven, holy to rest and remember, is a gift, not a burden. In a world that rushes, God still invites a quiet place to remember He is the Maker, and we are His, and the story is not finished, but the foundation is very good.
